title: WandaVision
summary: Blends the style of classic sitcoms with the MCU, in which Wanda Maximoff and Vision - two super-powered beings living their ideal suburban lives - begin to suspect that everything is not as it seems. (source: IMDB)

reception.actors: Elizabeth Olsen, Paul Bettany, Kathryn Hahn, Teyonah Parris
reception.awards: Won 3 Primetime Emmys. 25 wins & 92 nominations total.
